mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trn_spending (spending_amount, spending_date, spending_memo, user_id, category_id, custom_category_name, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{amount}, #{spendingDate}, #{memo}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{customCategoryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_trn_spending SET spending_amount = #{amount}, spending_date = #{spendingDate}, spending_memo = #{memo}, category_id = #{categoryId}, custom_category_name = #{customCategoryName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE spending_id = #{spendingId}
UPDATE tb_trn_spending SET delete_flg = true, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE spending_id = #{spendingId}
